piece.headline: One point. That is all that separates Nikhil from Matt
piece.standfirst: Nikhil survives a Haaland blank by the thinnest of margins, with Matt closing fast and Ravin tumbling out of the top spot.
piece.big_picture: One point. That is the whole gap between Nikhil and Matt. Nikhil kept top spot with a decent week, Matt arrived from 5th with the week's best score. Ravin led last week and now sits 4th. Deepak is lurking in 3rd.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Hishaan put the armband on Barry instead of Haaland. Barry gave 32 with the armband, Haaland gave 4. Nobody else dared to join him.

winners.name: Matt
winners.verdict: Matt's bench did the heavy lifting and dragged him from 5th to 2nd. Nikhil can hear him breathing.

winners.name: Hishaan
winners.verdict: The only manager to captain Barry, and it paid 32 with the armband. Lone wolf, full reward.

winners.name: Marcel
winners.verdict: Silva and Isak came in and both transfers earned their place. Up to 13th, and the bench was the only blemish.

losers.name: Ravi Mahtani
losers.verdict: Lowest score in the whole league. Down to 17th, and the week had no redeeming moment.

losers.name: Alia
losers.verdict: A rough week, well short of the league average. Gentle sympathy, Alia, and the group chat will go easy.

losers.name: Rohan
losers.verdict: Captained Haaland, got a blank for the armband, then watched 11 more points sit on the bench.
